verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a SaaS ATS, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a bulk data export, open-format download, or offboarding path. The paginated list endpoints with sync tokens and the MCP server's record retrieval are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not a first-party export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
